intent: Mark the levels of a breadcrumb trail that are collapsed out of view.
typical_uses: A stand-in for the middle levels of a long trail

dont_use_when.situation: The collapsed-pages marker in a Pagination row

invariants.text: The ellipsis renders a `span` with `role="presentation"` and `aria-hidden="true"` holding a horizontal dots icon and a visually hidden "More" label; children passed to it are not rendered. Because the label sits inside the aria-hidden span it is hidden as well, so assistive tech hears nothing where the collapsed levels are.

anti_patterns.dont: Make the ellipsis the only way to reach the collapsed levels
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the collapsed levels reachable some other way; the ellipsis is hidden from assistive tech and is not interactive

a11y.by: breadcrumb.tsx puts the visually hidden "More" label inside the span that carries aria-hidden="true", so it is never announced; breadcrumb.test.tsx asserts aria-hidden="true" and textContent "More" on the same element

unexposed_parts.reason: breadcrumb.tsx renders a MoreHorizontalIcon inside the span; it is not exported as a component of its own and cannot be replaced.
breadcrumb.tsx renders it as a span with the stylesheet's srOnly class; it is not exported and its text cannot be changed.

good.title: A collapsed level in its own item

bad.title: A custom label given as children
bad.why: The ellipsis renders fixed content and ignores children, so the label never appears.
